from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,requests
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1")
proto=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
catalogs=json.loads((OUT/"first_catalog_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
links=catalogs[0]["report_links"]
chinese={"一":"1","二":"2","三":"3","四":"4"}
selected={}
for x in links:
    m=re.fullmatch(r"(202[2-5])年第([一二三四])季度中国货币政策执行报告",x["title"])
    if m:
        quarter=m.group(1)+"Q"+chinese[m.group(2)]
        if quarter in selected: assert selected[quarter]["url"]==x["url"]
        selected[quarter]=x
assert sorted(selected)==proto["fixed_quarters"],"官方目录尚未给全部16固定季度"
initial=json.loads((OUT/"release_probe_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
reuse={x["quarter"]:x for x in initial}
jobs=[]
for quarter in proto["fixed_quarters"]:
    if quarter not in reuse:
        jobs.append({"quarter":quarter,"url":selected[quarter]["url"],"request_role":"FIXED_RELEASE"})
    elif reuse[quarter]["url"]!=selected[quarter]["url"]:
        jobs.append({"quarter":quarter,"url":selected[quarter]["url"],"request_role":"VERSION_LINK_COMPARISON"})
assert sum(x["request_role"]=="FIXED_RELEASE" for x in jobs)==14
assert sum(x["request_role"]=="VERSION_LINK_COMPARISON" for x in jobs)==1
assert not (OUT/"remaining_release_receipts.json").exists()
(OUT/"固定16季度官方目录对齐.json").write_text(json.dumps(selected,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def probe(job):
    receipt={**job,"requested_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),"attempts":1}
    try:
        r=requests.get(job["url"],headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"},timeout=(10,25))
        raw=r.content; assert len(raw)<4194304
        name="release_"+job["quarter"]+("_canonical" if job["request_role"]=="VERSION_LINK_COMPARISON" else "")+".html"
        path=OUT/"sources"/name; assert not path.exists(); path.write_bytes(raw)
        receipt.update({"status_code":r.status_code,"final_url":r.url,"path":str(path).replace("\\","/"),
            "sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw),"successfully_received":True})
        soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,"html.parser"); body=soup.get_text(" ",strip=True)
        receipt["title"]=soup.title.get_text(" ",strip=True) if soup.title else None
        receipt["displayed_datetime_candidates"]=re.findall(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}",body)
        pdfs=[]
        for a in soup.find_all("a",href=True):
            url=urljoin(r.url,a["href"])
            if urlparse(url).path.lower().endswith(".pdf"):
                pdfs.append({"title":a.get_text(" ",strip=True),"url":url})
        receipt["pdf_links"]=pdfs
        receipt["exact_quarter_report_title"]=selected[job["quarter"]]["title"]==receipt["title"]
    except Exception as error:
        receipt.update({"successfully_received":False,"error_type":type(error).__name__,"error":str(error)})
    receipt["completed_at"]=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
    return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool: receipts=list(pool.map(probe,jobs))
(OUT/"remaining_release_receipts.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("全16季度链接已在官方总目录定位；复用2原页，新增14固定发布页与1个同报告版本链接核对。")
for x in receipts:
    print(json.dumps({k:x.get(k) for k in ("quarter","request_role","status_code","displayed_datetime_candidates","pdf_links","error_type")},ensure_ascii=False))
